intro: You are the Air Traffic Controller! Issue commands and ensure airport safety!
description:
Aircraft are moving one after another. Grant takeoff and landing clearances and direct taxiing and gate routing. 
Select approach courses and instruct aircraft to adjust flight speed.
Use a variety of ATC commands to avoid danger and keep the airport safe!
All 40 stages will put your brain to the ultimate test!

This popular simulation series lets you step into the tower and master the art of airport traffic control!
With simple, intuitive controls, anyone can play! Just select the best command for each dynamically changing situation.
Take on 40 challenging stages, including high-stakes scenarios where you are dropped instantly into sudden emergencies and chaotic traffic jams!
The setting is "Centrair" (Chubu International Airport, Nagoya), a real-world Japanese maritime airport operating with just a single runway.
Experience air traffic control like a 3D puzzle while enjoying realistic, high-fidelity scenes of the airport and airplanes!
